# Env

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(patchwork)
    library(ComplexHeatmap)
    library(circlize)
    library(viridis)
    library(grid)
    library(ggrepel)
    library(extrafont)
})

theme_md_classic <- function() {
    theme_classic(
        base_size = 6, 
        base_family = "ArialMT",
        base_line_size = 0.25,
        base_rect_size = 0.25
    ) %+replace% theme(
        plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8),
        axis.title  = element_text(color = "black", size = 6),
        axis.text   = element_text(color = "black", size = 6),
        axis.ticks  = element_line(color = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        complete = TRUE
    )
}
```

# Make heatmaps of enrichments

```{r}
names_res <- sort(unique(c(coenr_rna$A, coenr_rna$B)))
nres <- length(names_res)
```

```{r}
enr_mat_rna <- enr_mat_atac <- matrix(
    NA, nrow=nres, ncol=nres,
    dimnames = list(names_res, names_res)
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(coenr_rna))) {
    rw <- coenr_rna$A[i]
    cl <- coenr_rna$B[i]
    enr_mat_rna[rw, cl] <- coenr_rna$enrichment[i]
    enr_mat_rna[cl, rw] <- coenr_rna$enrichment[i]
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(coenr_atac))) {
    rw <- coenr_atac$A[i]
    cl <- coenr_atac$B[i]
    enr_mat_atac[rw, cl] <- coenr_atac$enrichment[i]
    enr_mat_atac[cl, rw] <- coenr_atac$enrichment[i]
}
```


## RNA

```{r}
Heatmap(
    enr_mat_rna,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "peak coenrichment\n(98th percentiles)\nobs/exp"),
    col = circlize::colorRamp2(seq(0, 30, length.out=100), viridis::viridis(100))
)
```

## ATAC

```{r}

    col = circlize::colorRamp2(seq(0, 40, length.out=100), viridis::viridis(100))
)
```

# Make divided/triangular heatmap

```{r}
# ---- 1) Fix the ordering from RNA ----
# Replace NAs when clustering to avoid distance problems; keep the matrices unchanged for plotting
rna_for_clust <- enr_mat_rna
rna_for_clust[is.na(rna_for_clust)] <- 0

# Use the same order for rows and cols (symmetric matrix)
hc   <- hclust(dist(rna_for_clust))
ord  <- order.dendrogram(as.dendrogram(hc))

rna_ord  <- enr_mat_rna[ord, ord, drop = FALSE]
atac_ord <- enr_mat_atac[ord, ord, drop = FALSE]

# ---- 2) Color functions & legends (separate scales for RNA vs ATAC) ----
col_rna  <- circlize::colorRamp2(seq(0, 30, length.out = 100), viridis(100))
col_atac <- circlize::colorRamp2(seq(0, 40, length.out = 100), viridis(100))

lgd_rna  <- Legend(title = "RNA coenrichment\n(98th pct)\nobs/exp", col_fun = col_rna)
lgd_atac <- Legend(title = "ATAC coenrichment\n(99th pct)\nobs/exp", col_fun = col_atac)

# ---- 3) Empty canvas heatmap; we'll draw each cell ourselves ----
# (Use a dummy matrix with the same dimnames so labels render nicely.)
dummy <- matrix(
    NA_real_, nrow = length(ord), ncol = length(ord),
    dimnames = list(rownames(rna_ord), colnames(rna_ord))
)

ht <- Heatmap(
    dummy,
    name = "tri",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = TRUE,
    rect_gp = gpar(col = NA),
    show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
        # i = row index, j = column index, already in RNA order
        v_rna  <- rna_ord[i, j]
        v_atac <- atac_ord[i, j]
        
        if (i < j && !is.na(v_rna)) {
            grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = col_rna(v_rna),  col = NA))
        } else if (i > j && !is.na(v_atac)) {
            grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = col_atac(v_atac), col = NA))
        } else if (i == j) {
            # white diagonal
            grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = NA))
        } else {
            # NA blank
        }
    }
)

# ---- 4) Draw with both legends; optional diagonal separator ----
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_list = list(lgd_rna, lgd_atac))

# Optional: draw a diagonal line across the heatmap body for clarity
decorate_heatmap_body("tri", {
    grid.lines(x = unit(c(0, 1), "npc"), y = unit(c(1, 0), "npc"),
               gp = gpar(lwd = 1, col = "grey30"))
})
```

```{r}
pdf(
    file.path(pdir_rna, "Gaba-Glut_CoEnrichment", "heatmap_coenr_rna_top_atac_bottom.pdf"),
    width=9
)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_list = list(lgd_rna, lgd_atac))
decorate_heatmap_body("tri", {
    grid.lines(x = unit(c(0, 1), "npc"), y = unit(c(1, 0), "npc"),
               gp = gpar(lwd = 1, col = "grey30"))
})
invisible(dev.off())
```

## Add labels for top hits

RNA

```{r}
set.seed(123)  # reproducible repel

p_rna <- coenr_rna %>% 
    .[order(.$same_region), ] %>% 
    (function(x) {
        idx <- which(x$same_region)[1:8]
        x$label <- ""
        x$label[idx] <- paste0(x$region_A[idx], ": ", x$nt_A[idx], " & ", x$nt_B[idx])
        x
    }) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(rank_overall, enrichment, color = same_region, shape = same_nt)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_text_repel(
        data = ~ dplyr::filter(., label != ""),
        aes(label = label),
        direction = "y",             # stack labels vertically, move horizontally if needed
        nudge_x = 250,               # push labels to the right
        size = 2.5,
        box.padding = 0.35,
        point.padding = 0.25,
        min.segment.length = 0,      # always draw a segment
        segment.size = 0.25,
        segment.color = "black",
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red2")) +
    labs(
        title = "RNA",
        x = "DEG co-enrichment rank", 
        y = "DEG co-enrichment (obs/exp)"
    ) +
    theme_md_classic() +
    expand_limits(x = max(coenr_rna$rank_overall, na.rm = TRUE) + 8) +  # room on right
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
    # theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 30, 5.5, 5.5))  # extra right margin for labels

print(p_rna)

ggsave(
    file.path(pdir_rna, "Gaba-Glut_CoEnrichment", "rank_enr_vs_enr_rna_labeled.pdf"),
    p_rna, #width = 4, height = 5
    width = 100, height = 90, units = "mm"
    # device = cairo_pdf
)

```

```{r}
    rna = coenr_rna,
    atac = coenr_atac

    Map(function(x, nm) {
        idx_chg <- which(!names(x) %in% col_ids)

        x
    }, ., names(.)) %>%

    do.call(left_join, .) -> coenr_comb
```

```{r}

q <- 0.99

rg <- "MB"
df <- data.frame(
    glut = dsres_atac[[paste0(rg, "_Glut")]]$log2FoldChange_shr,
    gaba = dsres_atac[[paste0(rg, "_GABA")]]$log2FoldChange_shr
)
tx <- quantile(df$glut, q, na.rm = TRUE)
ty <- quantile(df$gaba, q, na.rm = TRUE)

p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(glut, gaba)) + 
    geom_hex(bins=50) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linewidth=0.25) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=0, linewidth=0.25) +
    geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linewidth=0.25) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = tx, linewidth=0.25, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ty, linewidth=0.25, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
        trans="log2",
        guide = guide_colorbar(
            draw.llim = FALSE,
            barwidth = 0.5
        )
    ) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(-5, 5), ylim = c(-5,5)) +
    labs(
        title = paste(rg, "Peak Co-Enrichment"),
        x = paste0(rg, " Glut vs. non-", rg, "\n(shrunken log2FoldChange)"),
        y = paste0(rg, " GABA vs. non-", rg, "\n(shrunken log2FoldChange)"),
        # x = paste0(rg, " Glut vs. non-", rg),
        # y = paste0(rg, " GABA vs. non-", rg),
        fill = "peaks"
    ) + 
    theme_md_classic()

p1
```

## Create long tables

```{r}
library(tibble)
```


```{r}
# RNA: gene x Region_NT
rna_long <- bind_rows(lapply(
    names(dsres_rna), \(ct)
    dsres_rna[[ct]] %>%
        rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
        transmute(
            Gene, Region_NT = ct,
            lfc_rna = log2FoldChange_shr,
            padj_rna = padj
        )
))

# ATAC: peak x Region_NT
atac_long <- bind_rows(lapply(
    names(dsres_atac), \(ct)
    dsres_atac[[ct]] %>%
        rownames_to_column("Peak") %>%
        transmute(
            Peak, Region_NT = ct,
            lfc_atac = log2FoldChange_shr,
            padj_atac = padj
        )
))

# eReg links (peak–gene–TF), keep direct/extended and weights
links <- ereg %>%
    subset(sub(".*_", "", eRegulon_name) == "+/+") %>% 
    transmute(
        Peak = Region, Gene, TF, 
        is_extended = as.logical(is_extended),
        w_region2gene = importance_R2G,
        rho_region2gene = rho_R2G,
        w_tf2gene = importance_TF2G,
        rho_tf2gene = rho_TF2G,
        eRegulon_name
    )
```


## Rank the shr LFCs

```{r}
rank_scale <- function(x) qnorm((rank(x, ties.method="average")-0.5)/length(x))
rna_long <- rna_long %>% 
    group_by(Region_NT) %>% 
    mutate(rna_rank = rank_scale(lfc_rna)) %>% 
    ungroup()
atac_long <- atac_long %>% 
    group_by(Region_NT) %>% 
    mutate(atac_rank = rank_scale(lfc_atac)) %>% 
    ungroup()
```

## Join with ereg table

```{r}
# Join peak–gene links with per-ct RNA & ATAC
pgct <- links %>%
  inner_join(atac_long, by = "Peak") %>%
  inner_join(rna_long,  by = c("Gene","Region_NT"))
```

```{r}
pgct
```


## Define support for peak->gene in Region_NT

Composite support score that peak drives a gene in that Region_NT. Combine:

gene enrichment (lfc_rna, padj_rna, or rna_rank)
peak enrichment (lfc_atac, padj_atac, or atac_rank)
eReg evidence (direct vs extended; importance / rho; TF->gene score)

$$
Support_{p,g,ct} = A x RNA + B × ATAC + C × eReg
$$

I guess I'll do a rank-based scoring of the RNA and ATAC

```
RNA_term  = max(0, rna_rank)            # only positive direction
ATAC_term = max(0, atac_rank)
eReg_term = log1p(w_region2gene) + 0.5*log1p(w_tf2gene) + 0.5*abs(rho_region2gene)

Weights: A=1, B=1, C=1  (start equal; tune later)
Penalty: if is_extended==TRUE, multiply eReg_term by 0.7 (or +offset for direct)
Bonus: if eRegulon_name contains "_+/+", add small bonus (e.g., +0.2)
```

I'm just going to roll with this but I think more needs to be done to check
how much sense the eReg term makes...

```{r}
# also for ranks (RNA & ATAC), cap extremes so outliers don't dominate 
cap <- function(x, lo=-2.5, hi=2.5) {
    pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)
}

pgct <- pgct %>%
    mutate(
        rna_rank  = cap(rna_rank), 
        atac_rank = cap(atac_rank),
        RNA_term  = pmax(0, rna_rank),
        ATAC_term = pmax(0, atac_rank)
    ) %>% 
    # z-score within gene
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    mutate(
        z_wR2G   = scale(w_region2gene)[,1],
        z_wTF2G  = scale(w_tf2gene)[,1],
        z_absRho = scale(abs(rho_region2gene))[,1]
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(
        dir_ok    = (lfc_rna >= 0) & (rho_region2gene >= 0) & (rho_tf2gene >= 0),
        eReg_raw  = z_wR2G + 0.5*z_wTF2G + 0.5*z_absRho,
        eReg_term = ifelse(is_extended, 0.5*eReg_raw, 1.0*eReg_raw),
        Support   = RNA_term + ATAC_term + eReg_term
    )

# I'm undecided if should scale within each gene (to prevent many peaks genes
# from being inflated... maybe we like those genes?)
pgct <- pgct %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    mutate(Support_gz = scale(Support)[,1]) %>%
    ungroup()
```

```{r}
#     ) %>%
#     filter(row_number()==1) %>%
#     ungroup()


# umm i messed up choice...


top2_pgct <- pgct %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Gene, Region_NT) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
        dplyr::desc(Support_gz),
        dplyr::desc(ATAC_term),
        dplyr::desc(eReg_raw),
        .by_group = TRUE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 2) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rank_ct = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

# summarise to one chosen row + 2nd-best info & margin + within15% flag
top_pgct <- top2_pgct %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Gene, Region_NT) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
        Peak         = dplyr::first(Peak),
        TF           = dplyr::first(TF),
        is_extended  = dplyr::first(is_extended),
        Support_gz_1 = dplyr::first(Support_gz),
        Support_gz_2 = dplyr::first(Support_gz[rank_ct == 2], default = NA_real_),
        Peak_2       = dplyr::first(Peak[rank_ct == 2],       default = NA_character_),
        choice_margin = Support_gz_1 - dplyr::coalesce(Support_gz_2, Support_gz_1),
        # runner-up is within 15% of the top (i.e., ambiguous choice)
        within15 = !is.na(Support_gz_2) & (Support_gz_2 >= 0.85 * Support_gz_1),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # add back RNA/ATAC & p-values for the chosen (Peak, Gene, Region_NT)
    dplyr::left_join(
        pgct %>%
            dplyr::select(Gene, Region_NT, Peak, lfc_rna, padj_rna, lfc_atac, padj_atac, rna_rank, atac_rank) %>%
            dplyr::distinct(),
        by = c("Gene", "Region_NT", "Peak")
    )

# choice margin = gap b/w 1 and 2
# and 'Peak_2' maintainted


### how exclusive is atac peak to its "home" cell type?

# Which (Peak, Region_NT) pairs are "home" (i.e., chosen)
homes <- top_pgct %>%
    dplyr::select(Peak, Region_NT) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::rename(home_ct = Region_NT)

# Join ATAC LFCs for all Region_NT to those homes,
# then compute home vs others within each (Peak, home_ct)
atac_home_vs_others <- atac_long %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(homes, by = "Peak") %>%   # <---- adds home_ct column
    dplyr::group_by(Peak, home_ct) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
        lfc_home = {
            v <- lfc_atac[Region_NT == home_ct]
            if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else v[1]  # should be length 1
        },
        max_else = {
            v <- lfc_atac[Region_NT != home_ct]
            if (all(is.na(v)) || length(v) == 0) -Inf else max(v, na.rm = TRUE)
        },
        atac_specificity = lfc_home - max_else, # <------ neg values mean peak not unique to that ct
        .groups = "drop"
    )


top_pgct <- left_join(
    top_pgct, 
    atac_home_vs_others, 
    by = c("Peak" = "Peak", "Region_NT" = "home_ct")
)
```

## Call AEU across cell types

Alternative Enhancer Usage

For a gene to be an AEU candidate, it must:
1. Be RNA-enriched in >=2 Region_NT groups
2. The chosen peak differs between at least two of those groups
3. Each chosen peak shows ATAC enrichment in its respective group (or good support score).


## Attribute AEU to NT vs Region

Split up NT and region.

For each gene, which peak was chosen in each cell type?

Two ides:

1) Association test

Contingency table (peak choice x NT or choice x region) for Fisher's exact
(and permutation across region_nt)

Also Cramer's V effect size (NT vs region per gene)

2) Mixed model/multinomial

peak_choice ~ NT + region (+NT:region? does that work?)


```{r}
# parse Region & NT

    tidyr::separate(Region_NT, c("Region","NT"), sep="_", remove=FALSE)

# AEU genes often have >2 peaks; collapse to top K distinct peaks per gene
```

### Association test

(effect size + permutation p)

For each gene with ≥2 peak clusters and ≥3 cell types:

```{r}
by_gene <- split(top_pgct, top_pgct$Gene)
assoc_results <- lapply(by_gene, function(df) {
    if (dplyr::n_distinct(df$Peak) < 2 || nrow(df) < 3) return(NULL)
    tab_nt  <- table(df$Peak, df$NT)
    tab_reg <- table(df$Peak, df$Region)
    # Cramer's V
    V_nt  <- DescTools::CramerV(tab_nt, bias.correct=TRUE)
    V_reg <- DescTools::CramerV(tab_reg, bias.correct=TRUE)
    # Permutation p-values (shuffle NT/Region labels within gene)
    perm_p <- function(tab, labels) {
        obs <- DescTools::CramerV(tab, bias.correct=TRUE)
        B <- 1000
        vals <- replicate(B, {
            lab2 <- sample(labels)
            DescTools::CramerV(table(df$Peak, lab2), bias.correct=TRUE)
        })
        mean(vals >= obs)
    }
    p_nt  <- perm_p(tab_nt,  df$NT)
    p_reg <- perm_p(tab_reg, df$Region)
    data.frame(Gene=unique(df$Gene), V_nt=V_nt, p_nt=p_nt, V_reg=V_reg, p_reg=p_reg)
})
assoc_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(assoc_results)
```

```{r}
write.csv(assoc_results, file.path(pdir_mine, "assoc_results.csv"))
```

Label:

NT-driven if p_nt <= 0.05 and (V_nt > V_reg or p_reg > 0.1)
Region-driven if the opposite
Both if both significant and similar V
Neither otherwise.

### Summary function for region vs. nt association

independent of the association test which is slow and weak

```{r}
summarize_gene <- function(g) {
    df <- top_pgct %>%
        filter(Gene == g) %>%
        tidyr::separate(Region_NT, c("Region","NT"), sep="_", remove=FALSE)
    
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    # 2A. collapse at the chosen peak per ct (already done), compute helpful shares
    # NT/Region distribution per peak (weighted by Support_gz_1)
    mix_nt <- df %>%
        group_by(Peak, NT) %>%
        summarise(w = sum(Support_gz_1, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop_last") %>%
        mutate(nt_share = w / sum(w)) %>%
        ungroup()
    
    mix_reg <- df %>%
        group_by(Peak, Region) %>%
        summarise(w = sum(Support_gz_1, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop_last") %>%
        mutate(region_share = w / sum(w)) %>%
        ungroup()
    
    # 2B. NT- and Region- association “confidence” per peak via entropy (lower = more specific)
    shannon <- function(p) { p <- p[p>0]; if(!length(p)) return(NA_real_); -sum(p*log(p)) }
    spec_index <- function(p) 1 - shannon(p) / log(length(p))  # 0..1; 1=perfectly specific
    
    nt_spec <- mix_nt %>% group_by(Peak) %>% summarise(NT_specificity = spec_index(nt_share), .groups="drop")
    reg_spec <- mix_reg %>% group_by(Peak) %>% summarise(Region_specificity = spec_index(region_share), .groups="drop")
    
    # 2C. pick the dominant NT and Region per peak (by share)
    nt_dom <- mix_nt %>%
        group_by(Peak) %>% slice_max(nt_share, n=1, with_ties=FALSE) %>%
        transmute(Peak, NT_dom=NT, NT_dom_share=nt_share)
    rg_dom <- mix_reg %>%
        group_by(Peak) %>% slice_max(region_share, n=1, with_ties=FALSE) %>%
        transmute(Peak, Region_dom=Region, Region_dom_share=region_share)
    
    # 2D. bring TF info (if a peak had different TFs across cts, list unique)
    tfs <- df %>% group_by(Peak) %>%
        summarise(
            TF_direct = paste(sort(unique(TF[!is_extended])), collapse=";"),
            TF_all    = paste(sort(unique(TF)), collapse=";"),
            any_extended = any(is_extended),
            mean_choice_margin = mean(choice_margin, na.rm=TRUE),
            mean_atac_spec = mean(atac_specificity, na.rm=TRUE),
            n_ct = n(),
            n_regions = n_distinct(Region),
            n_nts = n_distinct(NT),
            .groups="drop"
        )
    
    out <- tfs %>%
        left_join(nt_spec, by="Peak") %>%
        left_join(reg_spec, by="Peak") %>%
        left_join(nt_dom, by="Peak") %>%
        left_join(rg_dom, by="Peak") %>%
        arrange(desc(mean_atac_spec), desc(mean_choice_margin))
    
    # 2E. light labels per peak: NT-locked / Region-locked / Mixed
    out <- out %>%
        mutate(
            Peak_label = dplyr::case_when(
                NT_specificity >= 0.6  & NT_dom_share >= 0.6  & mean_atac_spec >= 0.5 ~ "NT-locked",
                Region_specificity >= 0.6 & Region_dom_share >= 0.6 & mean_atac_spec >= 0.5 ~ "Region-locked",
                TRUE ~ "Mixed/Weak"
            )
        )
    
    list(
        per_ct = df %>% arrange(desc(Support_gz_1)),
        per_peak = out
    )
}

```

example (first "NT" candidate):

```{r}
res_g <- summarize_gene("ABLIM2")  # use the exact symbol as in your tables (here ABLIM2)
res_g$per_ct   # rows per Region_NT (winner peak)
res_g$per_peak # rows per peak (aggregate, with labels)
```

#### Get gene-level calls


Combine with association test results, prefer the more conservative label:
- If assoc says NT and per-peak says Region -> “Both” (or “Ambiguous”),
- If both say NT -> NT, etc.

```{r}
names(gn_sum_all) <- names(by_gene)
```

```{r}
all_gn_from_pk <- bind_rows(lapply(gn_sum_all, function(x) {
    g <- unique(x$per_ct)$Gene
    pk <- x$per_peak
    n_nt_locked  <- sum(pk$Peak_label == "NT-locked")
    n_reg_locked <- sum(pk$Peak_label == "Region-locked")
    
    lab <- dplyr::case_when(
        n_nt_locked  >= 1 & n_reg_locked == 0 ~ "NT-driven",
        n_reg_locked >= 1 & n_nt_locked == 0 ~ "Region-driven",
        n_nt_locked  >= 1 & n_reg_locked >= 1 ~ "Both",
        TRUE ~ "Neither/Mixed"
    )
    data.frame(
        Gene = g, Label = lab,
        n_nt_locked = n_nt_locked, n_reg_locked = n_reg_locked
    )
}))
```

#### Filter

Apply these to res_g$per_peak (or to all genes in batch):
ATAC exclusivity: mean_atac_spec ≥ 0.5 (or ≥ 0.7 for Tier 1).
Decision strength: mean_choice_margin ≥ 0.5 z-units.
NT specificity: NT_specificity ≥ 0.6 and NT_dom_share ≥ 0.6.
(Analogous rules for Region specificity.)

Direct evidence bonus: prefer peaks with any TF_direct; require at least one direct for Tier 1.

Then summarize per gene

##### Genewise

### Multinomial model

```{r}
library(nnet)
multinom_results <- lapply(by_gene, function(df) {
    if (dplyr::n_distinct(df$Peak) < 2 || nrow(df) < 8) return(NULL)
    df$Peak <- droplevels(factor(df$Peak))
    m_nt   <- try(multinom(Peak ~ NT, data=df, trace=FALSE), silent=TRUE)
    m_reg  <- try(multinom(Peak ~ Region, data=df, trace=FALSE), silent=TRUE)
    m_both <- try(multinom(Peak ~ NT + Region, data=df, trace=FALSE), silent=TRUE)
    if (inherits(m_nt, "try-error") || inherits(m_reg, "try-error") || inherits(m_both, "try-error")) return(NULL)
    AICs <- c(NT=AIC(m_nt), Region=AIC(m_reg), Both=AIC(m_both))
    data.frame(Gene=unique(df$Gene), AIC_NT=AICs[1], AIC_Region=AICs[2], AIC_Both=AICs[3])
})
multinom_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(multinom_results)

```

I don't think a good idea.


### TF Context for AEU

If switch involves different TFs (and whether at least 1 is direct).

This is really what I want.

```{r}
aeu_tf <- top_pgct %>%
    select(Gene, Region_NT, Peak, TF, is_extended) %>%
    group_by(Gene, Region_NT, Peak) %>%
    summarize(
        TF_direct = paste(sort(unique(TF[!is_extended])), collapse=";"),
        TF_all    = paste(sort(unique(TF)), collapse=";"),
        .groups="drop"
    )

# per gene summary
tf_switch <- aeu_tf %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    summarize(
        n_peaks = n_distinct(Peak),
        n_TF_direct_sets = n_distinct(TF_direct),
        TF_switch_direct = n_TF_direct_sets > 1
    )
```
